output.name: constrain
output.purpose: Enforce configured test-value, dependency integrity, execution, artifact and repository sparsity constraints in the selected workspace.

criteria.description: Choose verification depth and category from the concrete risk and boundary.
Inspect independent behavioral oracles and distinct fault sensitivity before retaining tests.
Run the actual selected-workspace constraint gate and repair failures without automatic waivers.
Pin supported dependencies and identify runtime acquisition paths outside the verified lock boundary.

limits: Deterministic rules detect supported test, dependency, execution, boundary and budget defects; they do not prove semantic test value or verify downloaded artifacts by themselves.
Unlocked MCP runtime fetches and unsupported acquisition paths remain explicitly reported; recorded review does not authenticate reviewer judgment or native hook activation.
